Title: Public Preview: Azure HDInsight on AKS is now available for preview in 6 new regions

Body.Content: Azure HDInsight on AKS is now available for preview in six new regions -Norway East, Switzerland North, France Central, Central US, Southeast Asia and South Central US. For more information about Azure HDInsight on AKS, see the documentation.
